title: millegrana
intro: Millegrana, commonly known as Calea ternifolia, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The therapeutic actions of Millegrana include promoting relaxation, reducing muscle tension, and improving sleep quality, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential, but initial studies suggest that Millegrana may have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
